title: HPCG：時間占比與整體加速

scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

steps.instruction:
交付階段預算、同工作證明與效能解讀限制。
在交接件中加入「HPCG：架構、所有權與資料介面」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：首案100毫秒，SpMV占40%；改後總80，整體只1.25倍而非2倍；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以四階段時間條畫出依序執行，標清求解迭代數和驗證條件保持相同；100/80正確，工作與數值驗證相同，不能把階段加速誇成整機加速。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver phase budgets, equal-work evidence, and interpretation limits.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for HPCG: architecture,ownership and data interfaces: The baseline is 100 ms with 40% in SpMV. The changed total is 80 ms, giving 1.25× overall speedup, not 2×. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Draw four sequential phases with unchanged solver iteration count and numerical validation conditions. Verify 100 and 80 with equal work and numerical validation. Do not inflate a phase improvement into whole-system speedup. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。首案100毫秒，SpMV占40%；改後總80，整體只1.25倍而非2倍；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. The baseline is 100 ms with 40% in SpMV. The changed total is 80 ms, giving 1.25× overall speedup, not 2×. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 首案100毫秒，SpMV占40%；改後總80，整體只1.25倍而非2倍；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.checkEn: The baseline is 100 ms with 40% in SpMV. The changed total is 80 ms, giving 1.25× overall speedup, not 2×. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: HPCG以預條件共軛梯度工作補充稠密基準觀點；本課分解合成求解器階段。
knowledge.textEn: HPCG uses preconditioned conjugate-gradient work to complement dense benchmarks. This lesson decomposes synthetic solver phases.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 以四階段時間條畫出依序執行，標清求解迭代數和驗證條件保持相同；100/80正確，工作與數值驗證相同，不能把階段加速誇成整機加速。
knowledge.textEn: Draw four sequential phases with unchanged solver iteration count and numerical validation conditions. Verify 100 and 80 with equal work and numerical validation. Do not inflate a phase improvement into whole-system speedup.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 固定各階段工作時，總時間是階段和；只加速SpMV不能消除平滑、歸約與其他成本。
knowledge.textEn: With fixed work, total time sums phase times. Faster SpMV does not eliminate smoothing, reductions, or other costs.
